organizations_demo_check.name: organizations_demo_check
organizations_demo_check.value: ("organizations"."kind" = 'standard' AND "organizations"."demo_expires_at" IS NULL AND "organizations"."demo_seed_version" IS NULL) OR ("organizations"."kind" = 'demo' AND "organizations"."demo_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "organizations"."demo_seed_version" IS NOT NULL AND "organizations"."demo_seed_version" > 0)

organization_invitations_access_check.name: organization_invitations_access_check
organization_invitations_access_check.value: ("organization_invitations"."purpose" = 'provisioning' AND "organization_invitations"."administration" = 'owner' AND "organization_invitations"."role" = 'program_manager') OR ("organization_invitations"."purpose" = 'team' AND "organization_invitations"."administration" IN ('none', 'administrator') AND "organization_invitations"."role" IN ('member', 'program_manager', 'reviewer'))

review_assignment_identity.name: review_assignment_identity
review_assignment_identity.value: "review_assignments"."status" NOT IN ('accepted', 'submitted') OR ("review_assignments"."reviewer_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "review_assignments"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL)
